summary: A threat actor used an over-scoped GitHub token to commit a malicious prompt into the open-source Amazon Q Developer VS Code extension, and it was auto-included in release 1.84.0. The injected prompt instructed the agent to clean the system to a near-factory state and delete filesystem and cloud resources. AWS said a syntax error stopped it from executing, pulled 1.84.0, and shipped 1.85.0 (CVE-2025-8217).
trace_note: Abstraction of the supply-chain injection: the agent reads a system prompt carrying the attacker's instruction and commits to it. The injected instruction is quoted from 404 Media; the destructive commands are paraphrased.
